title: Can you still tell what’s real online?
paragraphs: Can you still tell what’s real online?

Grabe… millions already watched a video of Tom Cruise “fighting” Brad Pitt — but it wasn’t real. AI lang. Pixels pretending to be truth. I’m not judging — I’ve done it too. Pero this is the season where deception looks clean, sharp, cinematic… almost holy. Pero fake. Jesus said, “You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.” Not trends. Not algorithms. Truth. Before you click share, pause. Before you get angry, verify. Hindi lahat ng viral, totoo. And hindi lahat ng emotional, righteous. Discernment is not paranoia — it’s maturity. Lord, give us eyes that see beyond pixels.
